title.narrative: 20,582 people participated in community dialogues or capacity building on harmful practices, violence, and birth registration. The global gender transformative accelerator tool was introduced, and implementing partners were trained on social behavior change approaches. An orientation guide on FGM abandonment was developed for community actors and outreach workers.
